name: 大棚卷膜时间（温度/风速）建议

map.输入棚内外温度、风速与棚膜面积，给出通风降温建议与卷膜高度参考: Enter indoor/outdoor temperature, wind, and film area for ventilation and film-roll-height advice
map.📖 查看「大棚卷膜时间（温度/风速）建议使用指南」: 📖 View the "Greenhouse Film-Rolling Time (Temp/Wind) Advisor Guide"
map.建议通风量 = (棚内温度 − 棚外温度) × 棚膜面积 × 0.5 (m³/m: Suggested ventilation = (indoor temp - outdoor temp) x film area x 0.5 (m3/min); roll height = min(dT / 15, 1) x max(1 - wind / 8, 0.2) x 100%
map.以棚内外温差驱动通风量经验估算（系数 0.5 为经验值，单位 m³/min）。卷: Ventilation is empirically driven by the indoor-outdoor temperature difference (factor 0.5, unit m3/min). Roll height multiplies the temp factor and wind factor: 15C gap gives full open (factor 1); higher wind lowers opening (8 m/s drops to 20%). Wind > 6 m/s or indoor not above outdoor means no roll-up; above 28C / 32C give matching hints.
map.💡 温差 = 棚内 − 棚外；建议通风量 = 温差 × 面积 × 0.5；风速>: 💡 dT = indoor - outdoor; suggested ventilation = dT x area x 0.5; wind>6m/s no roll-up; roll height rises with dT and falls with wind
map.卷膜高度为占侧墙高度的相对比例，实际需结合棚型与卷膜器行程调整: Roll height is the relative share of side-wall height; adjust by greenhouse type and roller travel
map.风速>6m/s 卷膜易损膜，建议关闭风口或仅小幅放风: Wind>6m/s easily damages film; close vents or only slightly open
map.阴雨天或棚外温度过低时不宜大通风，避免冷害: On rainy days or when outdoor is too cold, avoid heavy ventilation to prevent cold damage
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不上传，结果仅供大棚通风管理参考: Pure front-end, no upload; for greenhouse ventilation management only
map.📚 深度解析：大棚卷膜时间（温度/风速）建议: 📚 Deep Dive: Greenhouse Film-Rolling Time (Temp/Wind) Advisor
map.按棚内外温差与风速建议卷膜开度与时段。: Advise roll opening and timing by indoor-outdoor dT and wind.
map.目标维持昼温上限、夜温下限与湿度阈值。: Goal: hold day upper limit, night lower limit, and humidity threshold.
map.用于病害防控与节能平衡。: Used for disease control and energy balance.
map.棚内 32℃（超 28℃ 上限）、室外 18℃、风速 2 级。建议卷膜 1/2: Indoor 32C (above 28C limit), outdoor 18C, wind level 2. Suggest roll 1/2 for 40 min to drop to 26C then shrink to 1/4; if wind rises to level 5, only slightly open the top vent to avoid shock.
map.大风卷膜易损膜、灌冷风致闪苗。风速预警下应减小开度或只开顶通风，保苗优先于降温。: Strong wind damages film and pours cold air that shocks seedlings. Under wind warning reduce opening or only top vent; protect seedlings before cooling.
map.一般夜间闭膜保温，但高湿连阴天可微开顶口排湿防病。看『温湿双目标』而非单一温度。: Usually close at night to retain heat, but on humid overcast days slightly open the top to dehumidify and prevent disease. Watch the "temperature-humidity dual goal" not just temperature.
map.大棚卷膜时间建议工具，根据棚内外温差、风速与棚膜面积，给出通风降温建议、建议通风: This tool uses indoor-outdoor dT, wind, and film area to give ventilation advice, suggested volume, and roll height, helping facility managers control the environment and avoid heat stress and film damage.
map.综合温差与风速计算卷膜高度比例: Computes roll height ratio from dT and wind
map.风速超阈值自动预警，避免损膜: Auto-warns when wind exceeds threshold to avoid film damage
map.估算建议通风量，辅助风机选型: Estimates suggested ventilation for fan selection
map.日光温室、塑料大棚春夏季通风管理: Solar greenhouse, plastic tunnel spring-summer ventilation
